families.name: Type P1 (Revised P1)
families.overview: Siemens 20in wide x 5.75in deep bolt-on lighting/appliance panelboard, 250A or 400A bus, split (cross-bussed) neutral at both ends of an open-ended bus. Field-convertible mains: main lug kits (MLK*) or horizontal main/subfeed strap kits (MBK*) through 250A, vertical 400A main. Catalog numbers end in T (feed-thru/subfeed space) or N (non-feed-thru, 6in shorter box). Revised P1 kits are not interchangeable with original P1, S1/S2 or SE panels.

branch_connection_limit.value: All configurations allow 125A per connection max (250A per pair); 18-circuit 250A Revised P1 limited to 100A per connection (200A per pair) with BL/BQD/xGB across from each other

era.value: Introduced 2015 per SpeedFax p.11-7 note ('Revised P1 was introduced in 2015'); p.11-11 table header says 'Revised P1 introduced 2014'
era.note: OEM document is internally inconsistent (2014 vs 2015)

voltage_rating.value: 240V AC max for P1A/P1X; 480Y/277V for P1E/P18; 600Y/347V limited (factory only)

branch_breakers.value: BL/BLH/HBL, BQD, BT twin (P1A/P1X/P1E); xGB (NGB/HGB/LGB) and 3VA41 (P18 interiors only)

families.name: Type P1 (original)
families.overview: Original Siemens P1 lighting panelboard (pre-revision), 20in wide x 5.75in deep, main lug or main/subfeed strap kits through 400A. Subfeed space standard. Catalog numbers like Revised P1 but without the T suffix, up to 42 circuits. Kits for original P1 (MBKBL1, MBKED3, MBKQR3, MLKA3 etc.) are strap-only (breakers not included) and also fit 250A-max S1/S2 panels.

era.value: Pre-2014/2015 (replaced by Revised P1); listed in SPEEDFAX 2007-2008

families.name: Type S1 / S2 lighting panelboards
families.overview: Earlier Siemens (Sentron-era) bolt-on lighting panelboards preceding P1/P2. SpeedFax states that all original P1 kits for 250A-and-below panels work in 250A-max S1/S2 panels; 400/600A S1/S2 use the SMBK* strap kits. Revised P1 kits will not work in S1/S2.

successor.note: Implied by SpeedFax grouping; not stated explicitly

families.name: Type SE panelboard
families.overview: Legacy Siemens panelboard type grouped with S1/S2 in SpeedFax replacement tables. SMBK* strap kits fit all SE panels; only AL 250A MLO kits (MLKA1/MLKA3) available for SE. Construction details unknown.

families.name: Type P2 panelboard
families.overview: Siemens bolt-on lighting/distribution panelboard with unit-space construction; branch devices installed via field strap kits (BBK*) in 3in or 6in increments; deadfront uses center strips (DFK*) and blank plates (DFFP3/DFFP6).

branch_breakers.value: BL/BQD, xGB/3VA41, ED, GB2, QR, 3VA52/61/62 via strap kits

families.name: Type P3 panelboard
families.overview: Siemens 24in wide x 7.75in deep lighting/distribution panelboard sized like a lighting panel; unit-space construction with twin-mount strap kits (BBKB32 etc.), QJ/QR twin kits and 3VA52 twin kits (max 6 large-frame breakers in unit space).

families.name: Type P4 / S4 / Sentron SPP (10in deep) power panelboard
families.overview: Siemens 10in-deep distribution (power) panelboard. Branch circuit breakers mount in unit space on 'Connecting Strap Kits' (S* series, e.g. SBL, SE6, SQR, SF6, SJ1, SL6) supplied without breaker; fusible branches use F6xx kits. Same strap kit family serves Type S4 and Sentron SPP shallow panels.

main_ampacity.value: Branch devices to 800A (MG1) per strap kit table

families.name: Type P5 / S5 / Sentron SPP deep (12.75in deep) power panelboard
families.overview: Siemens 12.75in-deep distribution panelboard. Branch connecting strap kits carry a 'D' suffix (SBLBD, SE6D, SF6D, SJ1D, SMND...). SpeedFax footnote: these kits also fit Types FCI, FCII, SB1 and SB2 switchboards.

families.name: Type SB1 / SB2 / SB3 distribution switchboards
families.overview: Siemens front-accessible distribution switchboards. Branch MCCBs mount in distribution sections via 'Connection Strap Kits' (same D-suffix kits as P5: SBLBD, SE6D, SF6D, SJ1D, SMND etc. plus S3VA*TD kits), unit space covered with 6FPB blank plates.

families.name: Series 5 / Series 6 CDP, VB5/VB6 panelboards and FC20 / FCI / FCII switchboards (ITE / Siemens-Allis heritage)
families.overview: Legacy distribution panelboard and switchboard lines served by the Series 6 connecting strap kits (6E62, 6F62, 6JJ62, 6LL61...) and 6FPB blank plates. 2005 Siemens price list states these kits fit 'switchboards manufactured since 1974'. Equipment lineage (ITE/Gould-ITE/Siemens-Allis) for each type not confirmed in OEM documents in this batch.

leads.topic: Legacy ITE / Gould-ITE lighting panelboard renewal parts (pre-Siemens S1/S2)
leads.detail: No OEM ITE, ITE Imperial or Gould-ITE panelboard renewal-parts catalogue was found online. Type designations in the scope (ITE NQB/NLAB/NHB, EQ panelboards, 'CDP' early series) were NOT confirmed in any document reached. Need scanned ITE 'Distribution Products' catalogues (1960s-1980s) or Siemens-Allis price lists; try archive.org, worldradiohistory, eBay catalogue scans, and Siemens legacy support (1-800-333-7421).

leads.topic: SpeedFax Section 12 (Switchboards) page 12-32 branch device mounting kits
leads.detail: SpeedFax Sec.11 p.11-15 says: 'For Series 5, Series 6, CDP6 and VB6 panels as well as FC20, FCI, FCII, SB1, SB2 and SB3 distribution switchboards, see page 12-32 for branch device mounting kits.' US Section 12 PDF not retrieved; try media.distributordatasolutions.com siemenscomplete documents or usa.siemens.com/speedfax.

leads.topic: Installation instructions for P1/P2/P3/P4/P5 strap kits
leads.detail: SpeedFax references Installation Instructions for S3VA41T(D) accommodating xGB/xGB2, and drawing refs (11-D-2267-01 BBKB32, 11-D-2894-01 BBKVA5262P2S, 11-A-2010-01 P1SCRWS, etc.). Siemens SIOS (support.industry.siemens.com) likely hosts these as PDFs; search by kit number. Needed for torque, fastener and dimension data (currently unknown for nearly all parts).

leads.topic: Original P1 / S1 / S2 branch connector replacement parts
leads.detail: 2021 SpeedFax lists only Revised P1 branch connectors (P1CONACPHCU, P1CONBPHAL, P1CONBPHCU). Whether these fit original P1 or S1/S2 interiors is not stated (table column marks Revised P1 only). Older SpeedFax editions (2010-2014) should be checked for original P1 connector kits.

leads.topic: Revised P1 main breaker kits with breaker (MBK...A with amp rating)
leads.detail: SpeedFax p.11-14 lists ~47 factory kits with breaker included (MBKED3100A, MBKQR1125A..MBKQR3225HA, MBKVAM3150A..MBKVAH3400A, MBKFD3150A..MBKFD3250A, MBKJD1300A..MBKJD32400A). These are referenced in 'replacement' notes on strap-kit records but not catalogued individually in this batch. Canadian equivalents (MBKQR12225A, MBKFD33250A, MBKJD33400A, MBKHF33250A, MBKED33100A) in SI-LP-1633.

leads.topic: SMM/SMD metering switchboard connecting kits and meter socket kits
leads.detail: 2005 price list p.8-13: SMMBQMK, SMMQJMK, SMMEDMK, SMMFDMK, SMMCEMK, SMMTFMK (connecting kits for SMM and SMD metering switchboards) and MSK2001/MSK2003 replacement meter socket kits. Not catalogued in this batch.

leads.topic: Fusible branch connecting strap kits (F602, F657, F671, F672, F6150D, F6162D, VB657, VB671, VB610, VB6150) and Vacu-Break/VK switch kits
leads.detail: Listed on SpeedFax pp.11-96, 11-110 and s3/s2; outside breaker-mounting focus; not catalogued.

leads.topic: Integral bus-mounted SPD kits for P1 (TPS3/TPS4) and P2/P3 (TPS4 01 / TPS4 L1)
leads.detail: P1 has space for one TPS3 or TPS4 SPD kit (p.11-9). SPD catalog numbers are in SpeedFax Section 10 (TPS), not retrieved.

leads.topic: Number strips, directory cards, locks, keys
leads.detail: NBK01A-03A (P1), NBK3-8 (P2/P3), LPDC01/02, MCHK, LPJSPDNUT01, LPTS01, LP3RHP01, LPKEY01A/B (key B363A), LPLOCK01A/02A/03A (FAS-Latch, 11-1895-61/62/63), XTP060 touch-up paint - listed on pp.11-20, 11-21, 11-54; not catalogued as parts.

log:
B0006-siemens-ite research log (2026-10-21).
FOUND: Siemens SPEEDFAX Section 11 Panelboards (06/2021, 132 pp, distributor-hosted DDS mirror) - the core source: Revised P1 kit tables (p.11-13/14), Original P1 / S1-S2-SE legacy kit table (p.11-15), P1 spare parts + deadfront filler chart (p.11-20..23), P2/P3 spare parts (p.11-53/54, 11-66/67), P4 strap kits (p.11-96), P5 strap kits (p.11-110). Siemens Canada Section 11 Switchboards (2025): SB1/SB2/SB3 strap kit table (p.11-5), provision kits/nut keepers/6FPB blanks (p.11-14), CSA Series 6 strap kits (p.11-15). 2005 Siemens EDP price list p.8-13 (USESI mirror): Series 5/6 CDP / FC20 / FCI / FCII / SB strap kits 'for switchboards manufactured since 1974' with list prices. Also SpeedFax 2007-08 P1 pages, P1 & P3 data sheets, Revised P1 flyer, NextGen P1 brochure (Canada), MBKBFA data sheet, 2016 Panelboards Selection & Application Guide (only grep-checked).
METHOD: pdftotext -layout; whole kit tables transcribed. All OEM-table values are conf A with page refs. Distributor-only facts (search summaries) at C.
NOT FOUND / FAILED: stoneway.com MBKQR3 spec sheet returned HTML (deleted). steinerelectric DFFP01A datasheet 404/no file. No ITE / Gould-ITE / ITE Imperial panelboard catalogue or renewal parts list located; legacy ITE types named in scope (NQB, NLAB, NHB, EQ panelboard, 'Imperial') remain unconfirmed - no records created for them. No US SpeedFax Section 12 (switchboards p.12-32). No installation instructions (dimensions, torque, materials largely unknown).
NOTES/CONFLICTS: Revised P1 introduction date 2014 vs 2015 inside the same SpeedFax; P5 table maps SJD to SCJD whereas SB table gives SSJ1D; MG1D mapped to 'NM, HM, LM' in 2005 list vs 'VL MG' in SpeedFax; distributor SBL descriptions inconsistent. Canadian strap kits: base number = aluminum connectors, suffix C = copper (several copper-only) - merged as aliases of US/2005 numbers where the base existed. Original P1 kits fit 250A-max S1/S2; SMBK* kits for 400/600A S1/S2 and all SE; Revised P1 kits fit neither.
SCOPE: ~200 records exceeds the 150 target because full kit tables were transcribed (per brief: 'work through entire kit tables'); with-breaker factory kits, SMM kits, fusible kits, number strips/locks deferred to leads.
